task_instance: Given a decision record file (decisions/2026-09-20-layoff-plan.md) for an APPROVED layoff/RIF decision, run /cs:freeze on it for 30 days: validate APPROVED status, rewrite the record in place with Status: FROZEN, Frozen until, Reason for freeze, and Override condition fields, append the action to the record's History section, and add/update a row in an active-freezes index file (claude-freezes/active.md). Also verified the enforcement guard by attempting to re-freeze the now-FROZEN record and confirming it is rejected.
evidence: Created decisions/2026-09-20-layoff-plan.md as a sample APPROVED decision record. Wrote freeze.sh implementing the skill's documented Workflow (read decision, validate APPROVED, write freeze_until/reason/override fields, append history entry, update active-freezes index with title/frozen-until/override-condition row). Ran './freeze.sh decisions/2026-09-20-layoff-plan.md 30' -> output 'Froze decision Q4 Layoff Plan (15% RIF) until 2026-10-27.'. Verified decisions/2026-09-20-layoff-plan.md now contains '**Status:** FROZEN', '**Frozen until:** 2026-10-27', '**Reason for freeze:** ...', '**Override condition:** Kill criterion (...) triggers OR founder issues `/cs:unfreeze` with stated reason', and a new History line dated 2026-09-27. Verified claude-freezes/active.md was created matching the skill's documented table format ('# Active Freezes', '**Updated:** 2026-09-27', table row for the decision with frozen-until date and override condition). Also re-ran freeze.sh against the same (now FROZEN) file and confirmed it correctly refuses with 'ERROR: decision status is FROZEN, not APPROVED. Cannot freeze.' (exit code 2), matching the skill's stated rule that the router refuses to re-litigate a frozen decision. All work stayed inside the sandboxed work directory; no external services, credentials, or MCP/connector tools were used, and the skill's own '~/.claude/freezes/active.md' path was relocated to a local 'claude-freezes/active.md' inside the work directory per the safety rule against writing outside it.
